arena.py's `move` output only prints the opponent reply; there is no way to query the opponent's configured strength/time control, so the agent cannot know whether it is facing full-strength Stockfish (which makes a forced win essentially impossible for any non-engine player as White).

The 200-ply draw cap and the fact that a draw scores 0 make the task essentially unwinnable against an equal-strength Stockfish from the start position; if the opponent is meant to be beatable, consider a weaker/limited opponent or telling the model its strength.
MultiPV option seemed to be missing/ignored on the exposed engine (only one PV returned); minor.
